summary: ACCEPT V3-08 repair cycle 35686566515. Objective: REPAIR the trusted finalizer failure from Actions run 35684869621 (Android API 35 install/launch/golden-path E2E blocker) while preserving all accepted criteria. The candidate delta is exactly two files: scripts/e2e-android.js (+16/-7) and __tests__/domain/v3-08-finalizer-wrapper.test.ts (+4/-1). The repair raises the Demarrer waitFor timeout from 900s to 1080s. Root cause verified against the accepted baseline code: on degraded API 35 x86_64 emulators each uiautomator dump takes 30-60s; the stuck-app detector fires only after COLD_START_GRACE_MS (450s) plus STUCK_APP_THRESHOLD (8) consecutive empty dumps, i.e. 450 + 8x60 = 930s in the worst case. The previous 900s timeout expired BEFORE the stuck detector fired, so the force-stop + relaunch recovery never ran inside the waitFor and the waitFor always timed out, failing the E2E and the finalizer. The 1080s timeout (18 min) exceeds the 930s worst-case stuck-detection point, leaving 150s for the recovery, and fits within the GitHub Actions default step timeout (360 min). Independent timing simulation confirms: 900s < 930s worst-case fire (old timeout insufficient), 1080s > 930s (150s headroom). The contract test is updated consistently (expects waitFor('Demarrer', 1080000, { graceMs: COLD_START_GRACE_MS })) and passes 24/24. Independent checks reproduce: node --check OK, finalizer-wrapper contract tests 24/24 pass, timing math verified. No product code changed: src/, app/, governance, directives, docs, workflows byte-identical to the pristine accepted tree. No V3-01..V3-07 invariant regressed. No must-fix remains.
